data.title: 毒蛇 · 晨曦床榻的蕾丝吊带小憩
data.description: 晨光透过百叶窗在洁白被单上拉出斑驳的光栅。毒蛇身穿粉色蕾丝吊带丝绸睡裙抱着大号羽绒枕，波浪长发蓬松铺展。她睡眼惺忪地微微仰起脸颊，泛着淡淡红晕，向镜头伸出一只纤白的手掌，软糯的唇角噙着清晨醒来时最毫无防备的黏人甜意。
data.location: sunlit morning bedroom with ruffled white sheets
data.action: lying on white bed hugging fluffy pillow, pastel pink lace silk camisole, messy pink waves, reaching hand out toward viewer, sleepy sweet blush
data.lighting: bright morning sunlight filtering softly through wooden window blinds
data.mood: clingy sweet morning romance, heart-melting tenderness
data.promptProse: Curled up on a white bed hugging a soft pillow in morning light, Viper wears a pink lace camisole nightdress. She reaches a gentle hand forward with flushed cheeks and sleepy, devoted emerald eyes.
data.animaCaption: Viper resting on bed in a pink lace camisole, reaching out with an affectionate sleepy smile.
